name: pergel
description: Let Claude draw in Pergel, the free 2D/3D drawing and landscape design program: write recipes, check them, draw with Pergel's exact geometry engine, look at the result and read volumes and quantities.
long_description: Pergel (https://uozdil-spec.github.io/sayfalarim/pergel/) runs in your browser. With this extension Claude opens Pergel, reads its recipe language, checks a recipe with Pergel's own checker, draws it (landscape plans, furniture, machine parts, small buildings), takes a picture of the view to check the result, and reads volumes, areas and the quantity take-off. Nothing leaves your computer: Claude and the Pergel page talk through a small local connection (127.0.0.1).
